rationale.description: One sentence on how the pointer was resolved or the title reshaped.

reminder_message.description: The repaired task title: an imperative verb plus a concrete object, about 4 to 14 words and at most 90 characters, grounded in the source. Empty string when the source carries no task (a question or a status remark only).

object_ref.description: The concrete thing the task is about, copied from the source words (PR/issue number, document or product name, a user mention token, a file). Empty string when there is none.
